crop.notes: Clipping is a middle section of the front-page story 'Fitzsimmons Wins Again'; the headline, the dateline opening and the later rounds are not in the clipping. The single Allen mention is included.

title.suggested: Tom Allen at the Maher-Fitzsimmons Fight in New Orleans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat listed Tom Allen, 'retired pugilist,' among the boxers in the boxes and reserved seats at the Olympic Club in New Orleans, where Bob Fitzsimmons beat Peter Maher.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, March 3, 1892, page 1. Fight dated New Orleans, March 2.

facts.fact: Allen attended the Fitzsimmons-Maher fight at the Olympic Club in New Orleans, won by Fitzsimmons in the twelfth round

notes: Result (Fitzsimmons in the twelfth) is from the page headline 'Maher Succumbs to the Australian in the Twelfth Round', outside the clipping.
